brief.name: Pocket Orchard
brief.pitch: Merge fruit seeds into bigger trees and solve small crate puzzles to unlock new orchard plots in a gentle, storybook idle-puzzle game.
mechanics: Merge matching fruit seeds into larger, more developed trees
Solve small crate puzzles to earn progress
Unlock new orchard plots by completing puzzles
Progress saves to the cloud across sessions
brief.art_style: Storybook illustration with warm greens and reds, soft hand-painted textures, and a cozy orchard feel
facts: Core loop is merging fruit seeds into bigger trees
Core loop includes solving small crate puzzles to unlock orchard plots
Palette uses bark #3B2A20, leaf #4FAE5B, apple #E23B3B, and linen #FBF3E4
Product is fictional and invented for a portfolio demo
not_true: No real-money rewards of any kind
brief.launch_goal: Attract players who enjoy short daily sessions

concepts.audience_note: Players who squeeze games into transit, lunch breaks, or waiting rooms. They want a satisfying loop that fits a small window and never punishes them for stepping away. Motivation: efficient, low-stress use of spare minutes.
concepts.angle: A full, satisfying session fits in about 10 minutes, so it suits a coffee break.
concepts.hook_line: Ten minutes. One orchard plot unlocked.
